basic_details.job_title: AFT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 15 LDC, DEO and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT), Regional Bench, Kochi will fill 15 posts in 10 cadres on deputation basis for a period of three years. The posts are Principal Private Secretary, Junior Accounts Officer, Assistant, Stenographer Grade-II (D), Lower Division Clerk, Data Entry Operator, Staff Car Driver, Despatch Rider, Library Attendant and Multi Tasking Staff. Only officials who already hold regular posts in government offices, courts, tribunals, commissions or statutory bodies, as set out for each post, can apply. selection_process: The Selection Committee will assess the information in the proforma and the supporting documents on essential qualification and work experience at the time of selection. The notice also names these post-specific tests:
Staff Car Driver: a test in driving
designed to adjudge suitability against the standards of competence essential in drivers of staff cars. Despatch Rider (from Group C Level-1 employees): a test in driving

designed to adjudge suitability against the standards of competence for drivers of motor cycles or scooters. Data Entry Operator: the speed of 8000 key depressions per hour is judged by a speed test on the Electronic Data Processing (EDP) Machine by the Competent Authority.
important_instructions: The period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or another Organisation or Department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed 3 years. If a deputationist expresses willingness to be absorbed against the deputation post during the deputation, the request will be considered under the existing Recruitment Rules (RRs) and the applicable policy for that post. The RRs are available on the official website of the Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT). Applications received without supporting documents or photograph, unsigned, or incomplete in any manner shall be summarily rejected. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later. Any attempt to canvass will be considered a disqualification. The office is not yet enlisted in the Directorate of Estates for allotment of GPRA (General Pool Residential Accommodation). In the proforma, Pay Band and Grade Pay granted under ACP/MACP should not be given as the pay of the post. Only the pay of the post held on regular basis is to be mentioned, and ACP/MACP details go in the separate table. Information under column 9(c) and (d) of the proforma must be given by anyone holding a post on deputation outside their cadre while keeping a lien in the parent cadre.

content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: The Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, functions from Bristow House, K.J.Herschell Road, Kochi – 682 001 (Phone: 0484-2217625). The circular was issued by its Registrar, A.V. Pradeepkumar. The Registrar also forwarded it on 13 October 2026 to the Additional Chief Secretary, Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department, Government of Kerala, with a request to publicise it across State Government departments and subordinate offices.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be filled in the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-I) printed with the circular. The candidate does not send it directly. The candidate's Department forwards the application of an eligible candidate, who can be spared if selected, to this address: The Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Bristow House, K J Herschell Road, Kochi - 682001 Fill in the Annexure-I proforma: post applied for, name and address in block letters, date of birth, mobile number, e-mail ID, service dates, qualifications, and employment details in chronological order. Compare your essential and desirable qualifications and experience against those given in the circular, and state clearly whether you meet them. Sign the declaration at the end of the proforma. Get the "Certification by the Employer / Cadre Controlling Authority" completed and countersigned with seal. Submit the application to your Department, with the enclosures listed below, for forwarding. Your Department forwards it to the Registrar, AFT, Regional Bench, Kochi, latest by 15 December 2026. The "Choice Station" in the proforma is already printed as KOCHI. If the space for employment details is insufficient, the proforma allows a separate sheet duly authenticated by your signature.

content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-I), signed, with photograph and supporting documents. Photocopies of the Annual Performance Assessment Reports for the last five years. Vigilance Clearance Certificate. Certification by the Employer / Cadre Controlling Authority: details verified, no vigilance or disciplinary case pending or contemplated, integrity certified, CR Dossier in original or photocopies of ACRs for the last five years attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or above, and a statement on major/minor penalties in the last 10 years. For officers already on deputation: application forwarded by the parent cadre/Department with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and integrity certificate. For applicants whose organisation does not follow the Central Government Pay Scale: the latest salary slip showing basic pay with scale and rate of increment, allowances with break-up, and total emoluments.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AFT Kochi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies across 10 posts, including 3 Lower Division Clerk posts and 2 posts each of Principal Private Secretary, Data Entry Operator and Staff Car Driver. The notice says the number of vacancies may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for AFT Kochi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must be forwarded by the candidate's Department to the Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Kochi, latest by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for AFT Kochi posts?
faq.answer: The qualification varies by post. It is 10th pass for Staff Car Driver, Despatch Rider, Library Attendant and Multi Tasking Staff, and 12th pass with computer skills for Stenographer Grade-II (D), LDC and Data Entry Operator. The Assistant post needs a Degree. Every post also requires a regular analogous or qualifying post in government service.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AFT Kochi deputation posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AFT Kochi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Pay Matrix Level-1 (₹18000-56900) for Library Attendant and Multi Tasking Staff to Level 11 (₹67,700 - 2,08,700/-) for Principal Private Secretary. Pay on deputation is governed by DoP&T O.M. No. 6/8/2009 Estt(Pay-II) dated 17-06-2010.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AFT Kochi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-I proforma and attach copies of the last five years' Annual Performance Assessment Reports and the Vigilance Clearance Certificate. Your Department then forwards the application to the Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Bristow House, K J Herschell Road, Kochi - 682001.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a driving test for the Staff Car Driver and Despatch Rider posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Staff Car Drivers are selected on the results of a test in driving. Despatch Riders drawn from Group C Level-1 employees are selected on the basis of a test in driving.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AFT Kochi appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on deputation basis for three years. A deputationist who wishes to be absorbed may be considered under the existing Recruitment Rules for the post.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate withdraw the application later?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets relaxation in experience for AFT Kochi posts?
faq.answer: SC and ST candidates for Stenographer Grade-II (D), LDC, Data Entry Operator, Staff Car Driver, Despatch Rider, Library Attendant and Multi Tasking Staff may get it. The relaxation is at the discretion of the Chairperson, Armed Forces Tribunal, if enough experienced candidates are not likely to be available for the reserved vacancy.
